findings.evidence: Line 64-69: statement and proof (`rw [← sin_sub_pi]; push_cast; ring`) involve no Bessel declaration.
findings.fix: Export it from a trigonometric module (e.g. alongside `Mathematics/SpecialFunctions/Trigonometric/`), stated without the induction-specific `((l + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)` cast shape.
findings.issue: `sin_sub_add_two_mul_pi_div_two` is a pure trigonometric identity (`Real.sin`, `π`, a ℕ cast) kept private here; the shifted-sine phase algebra it encodes is precisely what the phase-shift material of §5.3 reuses.

summary: The exported Bessel-specific results are the right set and need no extra annotations, but six of the eight helpers are general analysis facts with no spherical-Bessel content kept `private` in this file instead of exported from a canonical home, and one of them duplicates a Mathlib one-liner.
